CREATE TABLE "public"."PairOutcomes" (
  "completedAt" text,
  "contextVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "encoderVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "feedbackA" float8,
  "feedbackB" float8,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "modelId" text,
  "notes" text,
  "participationA" float8,
  "participationB" float8,
  "policyVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "scoreAfterA" float8,
  "scoreAfterB" float8,
  "scoreBeforeA" float8 NOT NULL,
  "scoreBeforeB" float8 NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userAId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "userBId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "vector" vector(4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "complete_observations_e04df2cf" CHECK (("completedAt" IS NULL AND "scoreAfterA" IS NULL AND "scoreAfterB" IS NULL AND "participationA" IS NULL AND "participationB" IS NULL AND "feedbackA" IS NULL AND "feedbackB" IS NULL) OR ("completedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "scoreAfterA" IS NOT NULL AND "scoreAfterB" IS NOT NULL AND "participationA" IS NOT NULL AND "participationB" IS NOT NULL AND "feedbackA" IS NOT NULL AND "feedbackB" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "feedback_ranges_f8fabbc1" CHECK (("feedbackA" IS NULL OR "feedbackA" BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND ("feedbackB" IS NULL OR "feedbackB" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)),
  CONSTRAINT "ordered_members_f8bc5df7" CHECK ("userAId" < "userBId"),
  CONSTRAINT "participation_ranges_62455506" CHECK (("participationA" IS NULL OR "participationA" BETWEEN 0 AND 1) AND ("participationB" IS NULL OR "participationB" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)),
  CONSTRAINT "score_ranges_0aab7461" CHECK ("scoreBeforeA" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "scoreBeforeB" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND ("scoreAfterA" IS NULL OR "scoreAfterA" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND ("scoreAfterB" IS NULL OR "scoreAfterB" BETWEEN 0 AND 100))
)
